text:
The design misses only the ringing spec, by a moderate margin: 13.2 mV measured against a 10 mV limit. The other three specs pass at TT. The sensitivities point to lower Bf, higher Lo and slightly lower Idiv, so I'll run a cheap numerical refinement.

One caveat: the program rounds Bf to an integer, so a ±10% nudge around 4.0 doesn't change the circuit. The reported Bf sensitivity is therefore suspect. The only real way to test it is to start the search at Bf = 3.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "Only ringing fails (13.2 vs 10 mV); other specs pass with margin. Sensitivities favour lower Bf, higher Lo, slightly lower Idiv. Start at Bf=3 so the integer-rounded mirror ratio actually changes; Iq headroom allows tuning ugf/pmr/zk.",
 "params": {"Bf": 3.0, "Lo": 2.5, "Idiv": 110e-6, "pmr": 3.0, "ugf": 250e3, "zk": 1.0},
 "bounds": {"Bf": [2.0, 4.4], "Lo": [1.5, 3.0], "Idiv": [80e-6, 135e-6], "pmr": [1.8, 5.0], "ugf": [100e3, 500e3]}}
```
